slot.brief: An LR circuit connected to a battery with given L, R and emf; find the current at a stated time using the exponential growth equation, or the time at which current reaches a stated fraction of its maximum.

stem: An ideal series LR circuit with $L=2\ \text{H}$ and $R=4\ \Omega$ is connected to a $12\ \text{V}$ battery at $t=0$. At what time does the current reach $75\%$ of its steady value?

verdicts.working: For an RL circuit, $i/I_{ss}=1-e^{-Rt/L}$. Setting this to $0.75$ gives $e^{-2t}=0.25$, so $t=\ln 2\,\text{s}$.

working:
$I/I_{\max}=1-e^{-Rt/L}=3/4$; $t=(L/R)\ln 4=(2/4)\ln 4=\ln 2\ \text{s}$.
